description: Painted scene in a stone-arched street. A bearded man in a striped-hem wrap gestures with open palms at a folding table, where a seated man in a dark tunic and red cloak writes on a wax tablet. A helmeted soldier with a spear stands behind the table, and a queue of townspeople with bundles waits on the left. No visible text and no frame; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
